description: Commercial grid tariffs of German electricity distribution system operators for 2026 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Patrick Plötz (Fraunhofer Institute for Systems and Innovation Research). This dataset contains commercial electricity grid tariffs for interval-metered demand (registrierende Lastgangmessung, RLM) common for commercial electricity usage published by German distribution system operators for 2026. Each record represents one operator, grid level and annual utilisation-time class. It reports the capacity price in EUR/(kW·a) and the energy price in €ct/kWh, both excluding value-added tax. Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
